Preview review (proxy for epic:#26676#1) · e802b06a47f1ec87badad6b8bcb6a7df750ddd44 · PASS

Run under ruling 6520722066 on #26676, on this PR's head (not `main`), as the dispatch for #28084 orders. One context-free reviewer was given only #28084's Acceptance section with the agreed hidden cadence of ruling 6522899149 (180 s), the console URL and the sign-in. It drove the console with Playwright at the head above, on `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, seeded admin), Console as a Vite dev server on the PR's `ui/` source, CRM Leads list, idle, 1440x900. One continuous real-time run: about 233 s visible, 780 s hidden, 82 s visible again. Evidence is on the never-merged branch `claude/issue-28084-proxy-evidence` (294da9e8), folder `evidence/28084-proxy/`. Times are seconds from the moment of hiding.

**1. Hidden: 180 s cadence, at most 4 reads per feed in the first 10 minutes, none after: PASS.**
- Approvals (`/api/v1/approvals/requests`): 38.69, 218.74, 398.77, 578.82. Inbox (`sys_inbox_message`): 38.81, 218.85, 398.88, 578.91.
- The read at about 38.7 is the foreground tick already armed while visible (the last visible tick was at -21.3). The following gaps are 180.03 to 180.05 s for both feeds.
- Exactly 4 reads per feed before the 10th minute. From 600 s to the return at 780 s there were no reads of either feed (at 180 s one would have been due at about 758.8), and no other `/api/` request at all while hidden.

**2. Becoming visible: one read per feed: PASS.**
- After the visible `visibilitychange` at 780.02, approvals and inbox each read once at 780.02 (200). No second read followed. A window `focus` event 3 s later caused none. The next reads were the 60 s ticks at 840.

**3. Control, visible: about 60 s: PASS.**
- Approvals -201.4 (page load), -141.4, -81.4, -21.3. Inbox -201.4, -141.4, -81.3, -21.2. After the return: 840.07 and 840.14.

**Method.** Headless Chromium does not change `visibilityState` on a real tab switch here (the reviewer tried bringing another page to the front and minimising, headless and under Xvfb). So an init script overrode `document.hidden`, `document.visibilityState` and `document.hasFocus()` from a flag, and hiding sent window `blur` then a bubbling `visibilitychange`. Chrome's background timer throttling did not apply, so the page's own timers set the cadence.

**Evidence.** [requests log](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/294da9e8/evidence/28084-proxy/28084-proxy-requests.log) (every `/api/` request with its time from hide, plus hide, show and heartbeat markers), [before hiding](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/294da9e8/evidence/28084-proxy/28084-proxy-before-hide.png), [after returning](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/294da9e8/evidence/28084-proxy/28084-proxy-after-return.png). The two screenshots are byte-identical: the idle list page draws the same before and after, which is the expected outcome for a change with no visual part.

**Notes, not REWORK.** No approvals badge is drawn (none pending for the seeded admin); the approvals request was seen on every tick. No `sys_notification_receipt` read occurred (no inbox rows to join).
